assert evaluate(r,e,p)=={'status':'supported','value':8,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}; assert (r,e,p)==before\\n# Missing conditions, verification, false, conflicts, canonical objects, and absent calibration.\\nassert evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},e,p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['z']}\\nassert evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{'z':1}},[{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'z':1},'verified':False}],p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}\\nassert evaluate({'claim':'b','conditions':{'z':1}},[{'source':'f','claim':'b','value':False,'conditions':{'z':1},'verified':True}],p)=={'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]}\\nce=[{'source':'b','claim':'o','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'conditions':{'z':1},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'o','value':{'x':1,'y':2},'conditions':{'z':1},'verified':True}]\\nassert evaluate({'claim':'o','conditions':{'z':1}},ce,p)=={'status':'supported','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]}\\nce.append({'source':'c','claim':'o','value':{'x':2},'conditions':{'z':1},'verified':True})\\nassert evaluate({'claim':'o','conditions':{'z':1}},ce,p)=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b','c'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}\\nassert evaluate({'claim':'cal','conditions':{'z':1}},[],p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}\\nassert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in actual)\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--check\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}}]}"}
